description: Collections are saved sets of documents and folders. They belong to the person who authorized this connection. action: list | open (`collection_id`; the members you can read). Pass a `collection_id` to `retrieve` or `search` over its one workspace to narrow either to that set: nothing outside it is returned. To create or change collections use `collections_edit`.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a `workspace_id` from `workspaces` action:list, which also says which node it is on.

name: collections
title: Collections
